predictions.pred_d_pooled_reverse_controls_are_selec: Control margin RMS is at most 0.10, median full-vocabulary KL at most 0.02, and top-one flip fraction is zero.
predictions.pred_e_pooling_resolves_the_split_failur: The pooled minimum behavior projection exceeds the prior even-fit OOD minimum 0.7981567 and retains zero control flips.

decision: All five predictions establish a stable pooled reverse OOD interface at gain one. Failure closes complete-family pooling as a repair; the forward/OOD rank48 program remains valid but uniform bidirectional identification remains false.
